purpose: Initial ranges for offer generation and illness episodes when scenario-specific measurements are unavailable. These are gameplay hypotheses, not historical or local empirical rates.
policy: The low-central-high band is a scenario-wide tuning range. Select a versioned central value for a run; do not reroll the band each quarter. Eligibility, provider existence, age, calendar, relationship, resources, and ongoing state gate every offer.
unit: Annual probability of at least one eligible offer being generated for a person in the named opportunity family, before the player chooses. Not chance of acceptance, attendance, employment, migration, cure, or success.
conversion: For a constant annual probability p, quarterly probability is 1-(1-p)^(1/4). If no eligible provider or precondition exists, probability is zero.

health_episode_model.interpretation: Illustrative annual chance of a new episode, conditional on the person being alive and not already in an episode of that family. These are narrative pacing parameters, not incidence estimates. Separate chance of recovery, lasting effect, and death must be modeled per episode and may not be inferred from this table.
health_episode_model.scenario_adjustment: No automatic adjustment by culture, country, class, or household label. Add a scenario-specific modifier only as a separate estimated record with a reason and uncertainty range.
health_episode_model.treatment: Treatment offers require a resolved illness episode, at least two coherent plans, time/cost consequences, and an outcome model. Unknown historical treatment is represented as care, rest, or support options with fictional outcomes; do not assign modern medicine to historical contexts.
